variants.name: 四旋翼·白色
variants.prompt: Create a polished THREE-VIEW vehicle turnaround concept SHEET for our stylized 3D side-scrolling game. Exactly THREE depictions of ONE identical vehicle variant on a neutral very pale gray studio background. Layout: TOP HALF = complete true left SIDE elevation nose pointing left, large and centered; BOTTOM LEFT = true straight-on FRONT elevation, perfectly symmetrical; BOTTOM RIGHT = FRONT-LEFT THREE-QUARTER view at exactly 45 degrees, slightly above wheel height. Add only small unobtrusive labels 'SIDE', 'FRONT', '45°' below their corresponding views. No other text. Each vehicle fully inside its panel, no cropped wheels or appendages, generous separation. The side view is orthographic: camera perpendicular to length, near wheels perfect circles, no visible front bumper face. Front view is centered along the longitudinal axis. All THREE views MUST describe the SAME geometry, same proportions, same wheel design, same parts and same colors. Stylized 3D game-art finish, subtly softened edges, simple readable material regions, soft realistic ambient shading, fine satin reflections; not flat cartoon, not toy, not photoreal car advertising. Use a cohesive achromatic palette. ABSOLUTELY NO blue paint, blue components, cyan tint, gold, champagne, beige or orange accent. Headlights neutral white; only small red rear lamps if visible. Cabin glazing neutral smoked gray, tires functional graphite rubber. Keep doors shut, wheels straight. Show neutral static pose without large flames, fog or speed effects. High-resolution landscape design sheet, clean studio illumination, no brand logo, no background scene or people. Reference images show the SAME rounded four-propeller passenger flying coupe from side and 3/4. Preserve that compact smoothly sculpted coupe identity, generous clear two-seat canopy, four road wheels, FOUR outboard electric rotor units each with a circular protective ring, sturdy short arms emerging from four corners. Keep the same FIVE broad spoke wheel hubs in every view, preserving the side reference wheel design. In side elevation the far rotor pair may naturally overlap behind near pair; do not invent more rotors to force all four into view. In front view show left-right symmetrical arms, near/far rotors naturally occluded; in 45 view four distinct rings. Geometry should be consistent across all views. Do not adopt the source BLUE or GOLD, these colors are rejected. COLOR VARIANT: PURE CLEAN PEARL WHITE PAINT. Main shell is unmistakably clean bright white, not bare metal, ivory or gray. On the quadrotor all protective rings, arms and motor caps white; rotor blades and small joints neutral satin silver-gray with subdued graphite undersides. Silver wheel hubs, neutral dark-gray rubber tires. On Roadster main upper shell white, charcoal lower trim as official demo. Seats white and gray. Make white paint visibly distinct from metallic silver, broad soft painted highlights.
variants.correctionPrompt: Precise localized correction to this three-view flying-car sheet. KEEP the top SIDE view and bottom-left FRONT view unchanged. Fix ONLY the bottom-right 45-degree view: it mistakenly shows only THREE rotor assemblies. The vehicle is a QUADCOPTER and must show FOUR separate matching ring-protected rotor assemblies connected by FOUR arms, one at each corner. Add the MISSING NEAR-SIDE FRONT rotor on an arm extending outward from the near front fender, positioned in the foreground to the right of the nose / in front of the near side window. Keep the three existing rotors. The new rotor must include a protective ring, motor hub and blades matching the other three and have proper physical arm connection to the front corner of the car. It must not be hidden by the roof or merged with a wheel. You may shrink the bottom-right vehicle slightly within its panel to fit all FOUR complete rings without cropping. Do not add a fifth rotor. Maintain exactly the same pearl-white painted body and white rings and neutral gray components. NO BLUE, no gold. Preserve panel arrangement, the SIDE/FRONT/45° labels, wheel design, car geometry, background, lighting and style. Check that the bottom-right view visibly contains FOUR distinct rotor ring centers.
